o.text: Borrowed from Arabic مُحَرِّر (muḥarrir). Cognate with Turkish muharrir.
From earlier *kürgek, ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *küre-, *kürü- (“to shovel, to shovel off, to shovel together”).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كم (gem), see there for more. Compare Turkish and Gagauz gem
From hör- (“to plate, to weave”) + -gü. Cognate with Turkish örgü, Gagauz örgü.
